lines.trans: Mathias, this is absolutely brilliant.
It is the sign of the breakthrough.
A breakthrough after so much tension?
Like a river breaking its dikes.
Like a great cloud bursting.
Vulgar men are going to disappear.
What does the text say about action?
Resolute action brings about change.
It is truly very striking, Noemie.
It means that now is the time.
We must go on the offensive.
Go for it boldly, Mathias!
Break through without hesitation!
Yes, we are going to break through together.

meanings.note: in a film, or doing something

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

meanings.en: to bring (person or pet), to take along

examples.trans: Bring him to my place tonight.

examples.text: Après, elles ne peuvent plus s'arrêter.
On mange, et après on part.
examples.trans: We eat, and afterwards we leave.

meanings.en: passer à l'attaque = to go on the offensive

examples.text: On passe à l'attaque avec Luchini.
examples.trans: We're going on the attack with Luchini.

examples.text: Ça va lui briser le cœur.
examples.trans: It's going to break her heart.

meanings.en: briser le cœur à quelqu'un = to break someone's heart

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
crever de faim = to starve to death

examples.text: Si vous réduisez mon salaire, je vais crever de faim!
examples.trans: If you reduce my salary, I'll starve!

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: dire la vérité à quelqu'un = to tell someone the truth

examples.trans: The agency isn't going to disappear.

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Le rôle est pour un homme.
examples.trans: The part is for a man.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Un grand nuage dans le ciel.
examples.trans: A big cloud in the sky.

meanings.en: to break through, pierce; make a breakthrough in one's career

examples.trans: We are going to break through together.

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

examples.trans: I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui... = I'm the one who...
c'est un signe = it's a sign
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
tant de + noun (no article): tant de tragédie

meanings.en: tant mieux = so much the better

examples.text: Ce n'est pas facile d'apprendre un texte.
examples.trans: It's not easy to learn lines.

texte.gloss: text; lines (of a play or film)

meanings.note: apprendre un texte = to learn lines
